sn11.16:1.1: On one occasion the Blessed One was dwelling at Rajagaha on Mount Vulture Peak.
sn11.16:1.2: Then Sakka, lord of the devas, approached the Blessed One, paid homage to him, and stood to one side.
sn11.16:1.3: Standing to one side, he addressed the Blessed One in verse:
sn11.16:2.2: For living beings in quest of merit,
sn11.16:2.3: Performing merit of the mundane type,
sn11.16:2.4: Where does a gift bear great fruit?”
sn11.16:3.1: The Blessed One: “The four practising the way
sn11.16:3.2: And the four established in the fruit:
sn11.16:3.3: This is the Saṅgha of upright conduct
sn11.16:4.2: For living beings in quest of merit,
sn11.16:4.3: Performing merit of the mundane type,
sn11.16:4.4: A gift to the Saṅgha bears great fruit.”
